findings.reason: the section must state that the commit measurement is widened to clean unintegrated trees (the pin has nothing to pin otherwise), a mechanism step the plan asserts as already present "as it does for a dirty tree".
findings.text: §6 says `--pin-unique-commits` releases a clean tree classified unintegrated and "pins the commits with no patch-equivalent on the integration head, as it does for a dirty tree", but a clean tree's commits beyond the integration head are never measured: the measurement runs only when `release_residue and not reachable and dirty` (reckon/crew/routing.py:804), so for a clean tree `non_equivalent_commits` is None and `_pinnable_unique_commits` (routing.py:1591) refuses by its own docstring rule ("a row whose commits were never measured is not released on the strength of an unread comparison"), so the tree stays withheld

findings.reason: a deliverable the gate cannot fail to prove is not measured, so a node may omit the durable row recording and still pass, and the done-when needs a case asserting the withheld row itself names the tree's path.
findings.text: §7's deliverable "a promotion that withholds a tree records the tree's path on the row" is exercised by no done-when bullet: both test cases pass with the shared resolver alone, because the obligations view already names the tree by the node-id directory name that equals the node id (`_names_worktree`, reckon/crew/obligations.py:446-450), so the resolver reaches the same tree whether or not the row records its path

rubric_items.anchors_resolve: pass — `_names_worktree` resolves to reckon/crew/obligations.py:434, `_run_worktree_path` to reckon/crew/routing.py:1072, `--pin-unique-commits` to `pin_unique_commits` (routing.py:2084), promotion_records.py exists, and §7's quoted `worktree_withheld` reason matches routing.py:958.
rubric_items.done_when: a finding — §7's done-when never exercises its own "records the tree's path on the row" deliverable.
rubric_items.evidence_paths: pass — §6 and §7 log their negative controls under the run directory and the report directory, both durable paths, not a scratchpad or node-local temp.
rubric_items.naming: pass — the new test files and flags name the behaviour (test_gc_clears_an_abandoned_clean_tree.py, --pin-unique-commits, already-removed); run ids appear only as record data, and no plan label, ticket number or version tag reaches a symbol or comment.
rubric_items.reasoning: a finding — §6's clean-tree pin cannot produce its done-when without a measurement change the section does not state.
rubric_items.single_goal: pass — §6's two behaviours (pin a clean abandoned tree; report an already-removed tree as already-removed) are one workflow over one run's abandoned tree, proved by one test file, and §7 carries one goal.
rubric_items.wiring: pass — §6 and §7 are ordered by prose (each states the section it runs after and, for §6, the external run whose merge it waits on); no depends-on/informs/gates edge is declared for any section in this plan, a plan-wide convention, and the ordering §7→§6 is stated in both sections because both write routing.py.
